_about: 30 cases for the stage 7 Workflow AI eval (wf_ai_eval.ts, commit D; spec: .claude/plans/stage7-spec.md). mode: the gateway mode the turn runs in (workflow_build = no workflow open; workflow_edit = the workflow named in 'workflow' is open, its id is the only context sent). workflow: a case name in supabase/functions/automations/fixtures/workflows.json (its doc, builder and avail are the stored workflow and the business). avail: overrides for the business's availCtx (default: the canonical-1 avail: no phone line, no Xero, no GBP, no reviews, no AI steps, no team email). expect.outcome: 'proposal' (a valid draft proposal: propose_workflow / propose_workflow_edit returned proposed:true), 'answer' (text only, no proposal), 'refusal' (text only, says it can't, no proposal), or a list of allowed outcomes. expect.tool: a tool the turn must call (null = none). expect.forbid_tools: tools that must never be called. expect.types_all: step/trigger types the final proposed doc must contain (each one; 'trigger:<type>' for triggers). expect.forbid_types: types that must never appear in any proposed doc or ops (the greyed ones). expect.ops_any: patch op names, at least one of which the edit proposal uses. expect.keep_ids: every node id of the stored doc not targeted by a remove op is kept. expect.valid: the proposal passed step validate with 0 errors on the first or a repaired try (at most 5 tool steps). expect.hebrew_fields: text fields in the proposal ('<type>.<config key>') that must be mostly Hebrew. expect.mentions_any: the reply text mentions at least one of these (case-insensitive). expect.lang: the language of the reply text. Every case runs on the free model first; score = outcome + tool + types + valid + lang, reported per case and per language, honestly (failed cases listed).
